scenes.text: It was a normal day for Leo. His shop was ready, but customers kept walking. For days, he faced the same question: who should he reach, and what should he offer? The clues were there, scattered across shopper activity, product interest and payments.

scenes.text: Could AI do this for Leo? Meet Market Metro: a simulated commerce environment where AI agents analyze shopper behavior, train models and test marketing campaigns. We measure how their decisions change purchases, merchant contribution and PayPal payment outcomes.

scenes.text: The agent studies demand and available stock, chooses twenty eight days of history, and asks local tools to train two models. Its decision summary, tool calls and results become checkpoints you can inspect.
